trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This platinum unlocks after every other trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI has been earned. Treat it as the final checklist item: finish the story, reach 100% completion, and clear all activity, collectible, and combat objectives. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy awarded for completing the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Play through the prologue at your own pace and follow the mission objectives until the completion screen appears. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Earned by finishing Chapter 1 of the main story. Progress through the chapter missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter concludes. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 2. Continue the main campaign past Chapter 1 and clear the chapter's final mission to unlock this trophy. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unlocks when you complete Chapter 3. Follow the main story missions through Vice City and finish the chapter-closing objective. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Granted for completing Chapter 4 of the campaign. Stay on the main mission path and finish the chapter finale to earn it. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for finishing the final mission of Grand Theft Auto VI. Make sure you are prepared for the finale with good weapons, armor, and a reliable vehicle. The trophy unlocks once the final mission is complete. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Accept the mission when it becomes available in the campaign and clear all of its objectives. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing The Cartel Heist. This is a main-story mission; follow the mission markers, handle the heist objectives, and escape as directed to trigger the trophy. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play during the campaign. The trophy unlocks on mission completion. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Earned by completing the story mission Headliners. Progress through the mission objectives and finish it to add this bronze to your collection. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Follow the mission flow and wrap up its objectives; the trophy is granted at completion. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Operation Savage Glory. Treat it like any other required story mission: complete every objective and reach the mission complete screen. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold trophy for reaching 100% completion in Grand Theft Auto VI. This typically requires finishing story content, side activities, collectibles, and other tracked categories in the in-game completion checklist. Use the in-game progress tracker to identify missing categories and clean them up systematically. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Perform and complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps and similar stunt activities count toward this total; look for ramps, gaps, and stunt-friendly terrain while exploring Leonida. Track your progress in-game and revisit dense stunt areas if needed. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type at least once. The official description does not list the types, but community trophy trackers report 9 activity types in total; confirm the count in your in-game activity menu and make sure each category has been attempted. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI; activity count cross-checked against public trophy trackers such as PSNProfiles/Exophase.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold medals on every Shooting Range challenge. The official description requires gold across all challenges; public trophy trackers report 42 challenges. Practice weapon handling, aim for accuracy and speed bonuses, and replay ranges until each one is gold. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI; challenge count cross-checked against public trophy trackers such as PSNProfiles/Exophase.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun Drone Race at each race location. Public trophy trackers report 14 locations; use the map or activity tracker to confirm you have a win at every location, not just 14 wins total. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI; location count cross-checked against public trophy trackers such as PSNProfiles/Exophase.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The key word is different: replaying the same race should not be relied on. Keep a note of which race events you have won and rotate through new ones until the counter reaches 20. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Defeat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find the fishing challenge involving Cal, learn the timing for casts and reeling, and score higher than Cal before the challenge ends. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game from start to completion. Locate an arcade cabinet in the world, start a playable game, and see it through to its end state rather than quitting early. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission in his mission strand. Stranger/side mission strands become available as you progress; follow Andy's missions to the last one and finish it. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Progress through Kenton's mission chain whenever it appears, then complete the concluding mission to unlock the trophy. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Work through Billy's available missions in order and clear the last mission in the strand. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger mission strands across Leonida. A strand means finishing that stranger's full mission chain, not just one mission. Track which strangers you have fully completed and prioritize strands while traveling between regions. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Complete every mission in Randy's strand and close it out with the final mission to earn the trophy. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Follow Tyrone's mission strand through to its concluding mission and finish it. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida. Public trophy trackers report 18 spots; visit each one and use the meditate interaction. Keeping a map checklist helps avoid missing a remote location. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI; spot count cross-checked against public trophy trackers such as PSNProfiles/Exophase.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal tied to Bret's activity/mission. Follow Bret's instructions, travel to the hunt area, and take down the specific unique animal required. Bring appropriate weapons and be ready for a tracking-style encounter. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three collectible card sets. This means collecting every card in each of three different sets, not just finding three individual cards. Use in-game collectible tracking or a map checklist to finish sets efficiently. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Perform the WAiNK It action at 100 locations. These are location-based collectibles/interactions spread across the map; track your count in-game and sweep regions methodically. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are tracked separately from story missions; check the in-game challenges menu for categories and progress. Pick shorter or easier challenges first to build momentum. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: While with your partner, reach a 4-star wanted level and then successfully evade law enforcement. Plan an escape route with alleys, tunnels, or vehicle swaps, and avoid re-engaging until the wanted stars fully clear. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops consecutively without letting your wanted level drop between robberies. Choose shops close together, plan a fast route, and keep moving before police pressure resets the chain. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Discovery generally means encountering or entering vehicles so they register in your collection/progress. Explore varied neighborhoods, parking lots, and roads to find different models. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Defeat five enemies during one activation of Combat Focus. Build the ability, enter a combat encounter with enough enemies nearby, activate Combat Focus, and prioritize quick, accurate eliminations before the ability ends. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Trigger an unscheduled departure at VCIA (the Vice City International Airport). The description implies leaving the airport in an unconventional way; experiment with accessing restricted areas or aircraft/vehicles and making a sudden exit. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This trophy involves Rhinos (military tanks). The official description is intentionally coy; based on the name and description, expect to steal, survive, or cause chaos in a Rhino. Prepare for heavy wanted response and bring an escape plan. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store while remaining undetected. Scout the store, avoid cameras or guards as applicable, and use stealth takedowns or quiet entry methods. If detection triggers, reset and retry. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Successfully rob five bank vaults and escape after each robbery. Each vault robbery must end with a clean getaway. Plan loadouts, escape vehicles, and routes before starting; repeating the same bank may or may not count depending on game rules, so prefer distinct vaults until confirmed in-game. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away. Locate an armored truck in traffic or at a stop, break it open or take its cargo as the game allows, then evade any response and escape the area. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every area of Leonida. Public trophy trackers report 52 areas; uncover the full map by traveling through each region. A vehicle or aircraft makes sweeping remote areas easier. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI; area count cross-checked against public trophy trackers such as PSNProfiles/Exophase.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for every gang. Public trophy trackers report 9 gangs; identify each gang's illegal operation location, complete a robbery there, and move on to the next gang until all nine are covered. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI; gang count cross-checked against public trophy trackers such as PSNProfiles/Exophase.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar or venue serving cocktails with an ocean-facing view, and order/drink a cocktail to trigger the trophy. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Escape a vehicle showroom by smashing through in a vehicle, in classic GTA fashion. Enter a showroom, get into a display vehicle, and drive through the glass/exit dramatically. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete a bowling action with a proper follow-through. The description hints at performing the bowling mechanic as intended; play a frame or game and ensure you complete the throw animation. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This trophy's official description is deliberately vague. It references a partnership with mass appeal; expect it to unlock during a notable partner moment or social/media-related milestone. Keep an eye on story and partner activities and check community trophy guides after release for the exact trigger. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Unlocks through making choices. Public trophy trackers note PSN tracking up to 500 choices; if accurate, this is a cumulative progression trophy earned by playing naturally and selecting dialogue or action options when prompted. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI; tracking detail cross-checked against public trophy trackers such as PSNProfiles/Exophase.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A tongue-in-cheek trophy that suggests succeeding on a second attempt. If it does not unlock naturally, try failing a retryable activity or mission once, then completing it on the next attempt. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness a strange or unexplained event. The official description is intentionally mysterious; explore unusual locations, side encounters, and easter-egg areas. Community guides will likely pinpoint the exact trigger after release. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Hit someone with a melee attack while performing a drive-by. Get in a vehicle as a passenger or in a position that allows drive-by melee, pull alongside a pedestrian or enemy, and land a melee strike. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 worth of marked bills using your contacts. Acquire marked bills through missions or free-roam activities, then use the laundering contact/system to convert them until the cumulative laundered total reaches $250,000. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across shops. Any shop purchases should contribute to the total; buy clothing, weapons, services, or other items until you hit the threshold. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property available in the game. Public trophy trackers report 8 garage properties; save money, visit each property listing, and purchase them all. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI; property count cross-checked against public trophy trackers such as PSNProfiles/Exophase.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles using the Scooter Bros in-game app. Open the app, select eligible vehicles you own or have access to, and complete registration for ten of them. Requirement source: official PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI.
